subject: Request to pause demo until vendor-intake / NDA are complete
messages:
From: Emily Lawson <emily.lawson@lighthousehealth.com>
To: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: procurement@lighthousehealth.com
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Request to pause demo until vendor-intake / NDA are complete

Hi Hannah / Marissa,

Thanks again for the run-through last week — we’re excited to see Redwood in action. Our procurement and security teams started the vendor intake over the weekend and flagged two blocking items we need to close before moving forward with a product demo with execs:

- NDA signature from Redwood (we need the countersigned copy in DocuSign)
- Completed vendor security questionnaire (I’ve attached the Lighthouse intake form)

Procurement indicated they won’t let the internal demo proceed until those are done. We had a demo tentatively scheduled for Tue, May 25 at 10:00am PT — can we pause that slot for now? Our procurement lead says they’ll try to complete the questionnaire early next week but asked for flexibility.

Suggested approach: hold the May 25 demo and reschedule for the week of June 7 once the intake is complete. If you prefer a concrete date now, Procurement suggested June 9 or June 10 as safe options.

I’ve attached: lighthouse_vendor_questionnaire.pdf. I can also have procurement reach out directly to your legal ops if that helps.

Apologies for the churn — we want to make sure the compliance gate is closed before bringing the execs.

Best,
Emily Lawson
Head of Partnerships
Lighthouse Health

Attachment: lighthouse_vendor_questionnaire.pdf (application/pdf)
From: Hannah Schmitt <hannah.schmitt@redwoodinference.com>
To: Emily Lawson <emily.lawson@lighthousehealth.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Thu, 20 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Request to pause demo until vendor-intake / NDA are complete

Thanks for the heads-up, Emily — totally makes sense to gate the exec demo on the intake items.

We’ll put the May 25 slot on hold. Can you confirm whether procurement will send the completed questionnaire back to this thread or upload to your vendor portal? Also please send the DocuSign link for the NDA once it’s live so our legal ops can countersign immediately.

Internally: I’m looping in Ben from Sales Ops / Legal to expedite the NDA. Marissa — can you tentatively pencil June 9 or June 10 as alternate demo dates (we’ll confirm after the intake finishes)? If procurement expects earlier completion, we can move faster.

Thanks — I’ll update the calendar once I have the DocuSign link and a confirmation from procurement.

Hannah Schmitt
Account Executive, Redwood Inference

Quick note from Legal Ops: we can initiate the NDA via DocuSign and track it on our side. Emily — if you can either send the DocuSign envelope or confirm which standard NDA template you prefer, I’ll get it out today.

Also attaching our standard vendor-intake-checklist for Procurement; it outlines the minimum items Lighthouse will need to return (SOC2 attestation, data flow diagram, retention policy summary). If Procurement needs anything more formal, loop me in and I’ll schedule a sync with Security.

Attachment: vendor-intake-checklist.pdf (application/pdf)
Link sent: redwood_nda_docusign_link.txt (contains DocuSign URL)

Thanks — quick update from Procurement: we’ve started the questionnaire and have routed the DocuSign envelope to our legal counsel. I’ve pasted the DocuSign link below and Procurement confirmed they’ll try to have the questionnaire back by end of next week.

DocuSign: https://docusign.com/some-doc-id (already routed to Lighthouse legal)
Vendor portal (questionnaire): https://vendor-portal.lighthousehealth.com/forms/8342
HubSpot record: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/123456/company/78910

Given the timeline, can we tentatively reschedule the exec demo to Wed, June 9 at 10:00am PT? If Procurement completes earlier we’ll move it earlier and let you know.

Appreciate the fast turnaround from your side on the NDA link and the checklist. We’ll keep you posted and upload the completed questionnaire once finished.

Best,
Emily
